text.text: Layered balconies bring greenery and informal interaction, turning circulation into semi-private social areas and softening the dense blocks.
Residential bridges connect blocks while creating shared spaces for movement, interaction and planting.
Fewer people share each hectare: 983, down from 2,667. Each resident has 27 m² of living area, up from 15 m². Balconies, bridges and half-houses give residents room to make a home their own.
A dedicated sports zone brings recreation closer to residents, with accessible spaces for exercise and play.
The government builds the structural frame and residents complete the other half to suit their needs, so each home gains its own identity over time.
